description: The worked theory has model \(\{p,q,r\}\), forces \(s\) to be false in every model, and does not force \(s\) to be true.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.trace_models_and_consequences :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.traceTheory
      ↑{Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.p, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.q, Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.r} ∧
    (∀ (X : Set Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.traceTheory X →
          Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.s ∉ X) ∧
      ¬∀ (X : Set Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom),
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.models Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.traceTheory X →
            Lemmatheca.Entry.HornClauses.Atom.s ∈ X
